Verdiscan API v1.0


REST API for Verdis Chain blockchain data — blocks, transactions, accounts, validators, DEX pools, and eco metrics. The same data that powers Verdiscan, available for developers.




24
Endpoints


100/min
Rate Limit


Free
Testnet Access






Introduction


The Verdiscan API provides structured, queryable access to Verdis Chain on-chain data. It wraps the Substrate JSON-RPC into clean REST endpoints, pre-decoding extrinsics, categorizing transactions, and indexing validator and DEX data.


The API is organized into eight domains: 
Block
, 
Transaction
, 
Account
, 
Token
, 
Validators
, 
DEX
, 
Eco
, and 
Network
.




Base URL




https://verdischain.com/api/v1




All endpoints are relative to this base URL. Responses are JSON.




Authentication




Note:
 During testnet, all endpoints are publicly accessible without an API key. Mainnet will require API key authentication via the 
X-API-Key
 header.
    


For future mainnet access, include your API key in the request header:




# Mainnet (future)
curl -X GET 
"https://verdischain.com/api/v1/block/last"
 \
  -H 
"X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY"
 \
  -H 
"Accept: application/json"

Block






GET


/block/last


Get latest blocks


›






Returns the latest blocks on Verdis Chain, sorted by block number descending.


Query Parameters




Param
Type
Description


limit
number
Number of blocks to return (1-100, default 20)




Try it: 
GET /block/last?limit=5

GET


/block/{block_number}


Get block detail


›






Returns full block detail including extrinsics, digest logs, state root, and extrinsics root.


Path Parameters




Param
Type
Description


block_number
number
Block number (e.g., 599)




Try it: 
GET /block/599










GET


/block/{block_number}/transactions


Get block transactions


›






Returns decoded extrinsics/transactions within a specific block.


Try it: 
GET /block/599/transactions








Transaction






GET


/tx/last


Latest transactions


›






Returns the latest transactions across recent blocks, decoded with pallet/call info.




Param
Type
Description


limit
number
Number of transactions (1-100, default 20)




Try it: 
GET /tx/last?limit=10










GET


/tx/{hash}


Transaction detail


›






Returns full transaction detail by hash, including decoded call data, signer, block info, and event logs.


Try it: 
GET /tx/0x0000








Account






GET


/account/{address}


Account detail


›






Returns account balance, nonce, and identity information.




Param
Type
Description


address
string
SS58 address (e.g., 5GrwvaEF...)




Try it: 
GET /account/5GrwvaEF...










GET


/account/{address}/transactions


Account transactions


›






Returns transactions associated with an account (as signer or involved party).




Param
Type
Description


limit
number
Results per page (1-100, default 20)


page
number
Page number (default 1)












GET


/account/{address}/transfers


Account transfers


›






Returns transfer history (VRDX token transfers) for an account.

DEX






GET


/dex/pools


All AMM pools


›

Try it:

/dex/pools/{pool_id}


Pool detail


›

GET

Recent swaps


›

Param
Type
Description


limit
number

Error Reference






Code
Name
Description


200
OK
Request successful


400
Bad Request
Invalid parameters


404
Not Found
Block, transaction, or account not found


429
Rate Limited
Too many requests — exceeded rate limit


500
Internal Error
RPC node unavailable or query failed


503
Service Unavailable
Node is syncing or unavailable
